name: creabb/media-grid-image
title: Image
description: Insert an image to make a visual statement.

attributes.label: Attachment ID
attributes.help: The image is rendered from this attachment, not from the URL below.

attributes.label: Image URL
attributes.help: Source URL of the picked image. The rendering resolves the file from the attachment ID above and does not read this value.

attributes.label: Image width
attributes.help: Width stored by the editor's image size control. The rendering takes the width from the attachment file instead.

attributes.label: Image height
attributes.help: Height stored by the editor's image size control. The rendering takes the height from the attachment file instead.

attributes.label: Image size
attributes.help: Registered image size the file is loaded at. An empty value falls back to the full size.

attributes.label: Link destination
attributes.help: Where a click on the image leads: nowhere, the image file, or the attachment page.

attributes.label: Link target
attributes.help: The rendered link uses the target of the surrounding media grid.

attributes.label: Media fit
attributes.help: How the media fills its container: Cover, Contain, or the dimensions set below.

attributes.label: Media height
attributes.help: Only used with Set dimensions. Numeric value without a unit; pixels are added on output.

attributes.label: Media width
attributes.help: Only used with Set dimensions. Numeric value without a unit; pixels are added on output.

attributes.label: Media alignment
attributes.help: Alignment of the media inside its container. An empty value falls back to Center.

attributes.label: Block ID
attributes.help: Unique identifier of this block. It links the block to its generated inline CSS and must not be changed.

attributes.label: Parent block ID
attributes.help: Block ID of the surrounding media grid. It supplies the item style and the link target.
